correctness.rationale: For all finite complete multipartite parts n_i≥1, r≥2, the reflexive neighborhood R(v)=(V\P_i)∪{v}. Partitioning X into empty, single-part, and multiple-part cases proves exactly 3 global points plus two rough pairs for each proper nonempty subset of a part; coordinatewise order gives two horizontal Boolean sums glued ordinally. The comparability components of the proper nonzero part of H identify each m≥3 Boolean block and merge the two isolated atoms of every m=2 block, yielding the stated full automorphism group squared and recovery up to singleton parts. Modular/distributive thresholds follow explicit M3/N5 witness configurations. Independent direct subset enumeration on seven selected profiles, including all-singleton and mixed higher blocks, matched exact cardinality. The source verify.py is exact for 134 bounded ordered profiles; those experiments are not used to infer unrestricted theorem.
